overview: The Medford City Council considered a $740,000 supplemental budget amendment, approved an ordinance establishing a Cannabis Commission, and granted a utility location permit on Medford Street while tabling another on Riverside Avenue. The council also voted to enter executive session regarding small cell telecommunications siting litigation.

items.title: Executive session request on small cell telecommunications
items.summary: The council voted to enter executive session to discuss strategy regarding potential litigation with Verizon Wireless over small cell telecommunications equipment siting.

items.title: FY 2021 supplemental budget amendment
items.summary: The council tabled indefinitely a proposed $740,000 budget amendment following extensive debate regarding the funding and creation of a full-time election coordinator position.

items.title: Cannabis Commission ordinance third reading
items.summary: The council removed the paper from the table and approved the third reading of an ordinance creating a local Cannabis Commission.

items.title: Grant of location hearing for Riverside Avenue gas main
items.summary: The council tabled the continued public hearing to December 8 to allow city legal counsel and National Grid to finalize negotiations on street curbing mitigation.

items.title: Grant of location hearing for Medford Street gas main
items.summary: The council approved National Grid's petition to install 532 feet of plastic gas main on Winter Hill Road and Medford Street subject to 11 engineering conditions.

items.title: Condolences, committee reports, and meeting records
items.summary: The council approved condolence resolutions for Leo McHugh and Trieste Silvio, accepted an Ordinance Subcommittee report, and approved the records of prior meetings.
